title: Hunter's Leap
subtitle: Quest: Lilitha's Broken Bow, then have Eldrista fix it
steps: In the Facility Hub, talk to the Warden about Lilitha's bow.
Take the level 20 portal to Hunter's Leap.
Take it to Eldrista the Adventurer (portal in the hub) to have it fixed.
Show the working bow to the Warden for the reward.

notes.title: Quest item
notes.body: The bow is placed in the data, so the route goes straight to it.

notes.title: Locked door
notes.body: One door on the upper level (level 6) is locked and needs a master key or lockpicking.

notes.title: Hazards
notes.body: Cutthroats (level 40) and Highwaymen (level 50) are tough for this hub level. A Lich Lord (level 60) is also in here.
